plain_english: Having withdrawn from all thought — I thus cultivating thought-free own-consciousness direct attains.
sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtya sarvataś cintām [aha]m ity anuśīlayan | avikalpāṃ svasaṃvittiṃ pratyakṣāṃ pratipadyate

plain_english: Infinite, such-formed, in acceptance even, one-character — that own-consciousness entered — thoughts not should-imagine.
sanskrit_cite: anantaitāvadākārasvīkāre 'py ekalakṣaṇām | tāṃ svasaṃvidam āviśya vikalpān na vikalpayet

plain_english: Khecarī-etc., four-streams, flow, full, great-lakes — sky-goddess, self-consciousness — having dived, should-agitate inert.
sanskrit_cite: khecaryādicatussrotovāhapūrṇamahāhradām | vyomeśvarīm ātmacitiṃ vigāhya broḍayej jaḍam

plain_english: Creation, maintenance, dissolution, concealment, grace — by sequence, five-doing — Śiva I — thus should-trust.
sanskrit_cite: sargasthāpanasaṃhāranigrahānugrahakramāt pañcakṛtyāni | kurvāṇaḥ śivo 'ham iti viśvaset

plain_english: By sequence-of-projection-knowledge-enumeration, by guru's word, those in self considered — accomplished becomes.
sanskrit_cite: kṣepajñānaprasaṃkhyā[naga]tinādakrameṇa vā guruvaktreṇa | tāny ātmany ākalayya kṛtī bhavet

plain_english: Having imagined world-self Bhairava I — mine indeed those world-modes — as fire's flame-modes, sun's radiance.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpayitvā viśvātmā bhairavo 'haṃ mamaiva tāḥ | viśvabhaṅgyo yathā vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ

plain_english: One I measurer, knowing, measure, measured, having-kinds — pure-knowledge-etc. by-form — Khecarī-etc. fourteen.
